name: Eclat Forever Machinery Co., Ltd.
summary: Eclat Forever Machinery Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of printed circuit board process machinery and equipment, liquid crystal displays, IC flip chip substrate FCBGA peripheral equipment and automation machinery, and equipment in Taiwan and internationally. The company offers wet process production equipment, such as display manufacturing wet process equipment, horizontal wet process for high-end carriers, and vertical wet process equipment for high-end carrier plates; and design concept, film peeling and bonding solutions, glass and film roll-to-roll lamination solutions, MLO mechanical stripping and removal solution, and high-viscosity PI FILM peeling equipment.
